overview.title: Overview
overview.body:
# Overview
Tic-Tac-Toe is a two-player game played on a 3×3 grid.

One player is **X** and the other is **O**. Players take turns placing their mark in an empty space.

goal.title: Goal of the Game
goal.body:
# Goal
Win by placing three of your marks in a row.

A row can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.

board.title: The Board
board.body:
# The Board
The board has 9 spaces arranged in a 3×3 grid.

At the start of the game, all spaces are empty.

turn-structure.title: Taking a Turn
turn-structure.body:
# Taking a Turn
On your turn:

1. Choose one empty space.
2. Place your mark there.
3. Check whether you have won.

Then the other player takes a turn.

winning.title: Winning
winning.body:
# Winning
You win immediately if you create a line of three of your marks.

Winning lines can be:

- three across
- three down
- three diagonally

draws.title: Draws
draws.body:
# Draws
If all 9 spaces are filled and neither player has three in a row, the game ends in a draw.

strategy.title: Basic Strategy
strategy.body:
# Basic Strategy
Good beginner strategy:

- Try to take the center.
- Block your opponent if they have two in a row.
- Create threats where you could win next turn.
- Watch the diagonals.
